metadata.description: Flutter Design System - CastleKeep & SkyGo brands

CKButton.name: CKButton
CKButton.description: Primary button component with semantic color variants and size options

primary.description: Default filled button, high visual emphasis

secondary.description: Filled button with lower emphasis than primary

props.onPressed: VoidCallback? - Callback when button is pressed
props.isFullWidth: bool (default: false) - Stretches to full width
props.hoverStyle: ButtonHoverStyle (default: lift) - Mouse hover effect: lift, grow or none; presses always scale down briefly
props.size: ButtonSize (default: md) - xs, sm, md, lg, xl

examples: CKButton.destructive(onPressed: handleDelete, child: Text('Delete'), size: ButtonSize.lg)
CKButton(onPressed: null, child: Text('Disabled'), disabled: true)
CKButton(onPressed: handleSubmit, child: Text('Submit'), loading: true, isFullWidth: true)

props.label: String? - When set, renders an extended FAB

CKTextField.name: CKTextField
CKTextField.description: Text field with validation, helper and success states
CKTextField.basicUsage:
CKTextField(
  label: 'Email',
  hint: 'user@example.com',
  validator: (v) => v?.contains('@') == true ? null : 'Invalid email'
)
examples: CKTextField(label: 'Email', isRequired: true, validator: (v) => v?.contains('@') == true ? null : 'Invalid')
CKTextField(label: 'Bio', maxLines: 3, hint: 'Tell us about yourself')

CKSearchField.name: CKSearchField
CKSearchField.description: Search field optimized for search queries

props.onClear: VoidCallback? - Called when the clear button is pressed

CKCheckbox.name: CKCheckbox
CKCheckbox.description: Checkbox with optional label and status variants
CKCheckbox.basicUsage:
CKCheckbox(
  value: isSelected,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => isSelected = v)
)

CKSwitch.name: CKSwitch
CKSwitch.basicUsage:
CKSwitch(
  value: isEnabled,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => isEnabled = v)
)

CKDropdown.name: CKDropdown
CKDropdown.basicUsage:
CKDropdown<String>(
  items: [DropdownMenuItem(value: 'opt1', child: Text('Option 1'))],
  value: selected,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => selected = v),
  label: 'Select'
)

CKAvatar.name: CKAvatar
CKAvatar.description: Circular/square avatar with initials, image, and status indicator
CKAvatar.basicUsage:
CKAvatar(
  initials: 'JD',
  size: AvatarSize.md,
  status: AvatarStatus.online
)

props.status: AvatarStatus? - Status indicator (online, away, busy, offline)
props.square: bool (default: false) - Square instead of circle

CKBadge.name: CKBadge
CKBadge.description: Badge component for labels, counts, and status indicators

props.label: String - Badge text (required)
props.variant: BadgeVariant (default: primary) - or use the named constructors, e.g. CKBadge.success

CKCard.name: CKCard
CKCard.description: Card container with optional media, title, description, and action
CKCard.basicUsage:
CKCard(
  title: 'Report',
  description: 'Q4 2026 Summary',
  media: Image.network('url')
)

props.title: String - Card title
props.subtitle: String? - Subtitle text
props.variant: CardVariant (default: defaultCard) - defaultCard, success, warning, error, info

CKDialog.name: CKDialog
CKDialog.description: Modal dialog with title, content, and action buttons
CKDialog.basicUsage:
showDialog(
  context: context,
  builder: (ctx) => CKDialog(
    title: 'Confirm',
    content: Text('Are you sure?'),
    onConfirm: handleConfirm,
    onCancel: handleCancel
  )
)

props.title: String? - Dialog title
props.showClose: bool (default: true) - Show the close button

CKDataTable.name: CKDataTable
CKDataTable.description: Advanced data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, and inline editing
CKDataTable.basicUsage:
CKDataTable(
  columns: [
    CKTableColumn(key: 'name', label: 'Name', sortable: true),
    CKTableColumn(key: 'email', label: 'Email')
  ],
  rows: data,
  sortColumnKey: 'name',
  onSortChanged: (key, ascending) => handleSort(key, ascending)
)
features: Custom column types (text, badge, avatarText, progress, custom)

props.title: String? - Table title
props.subtitle: String? - Table subtitle
props.totalCount: int (default: 0) - Total rows across all pages
props.onCellValueChanged: (rowKey, columnKey, newValue) - Called when an editable cell changes

examples: CKDataTable(columns: cols, rows: data, selectionMode: TableSelectionMode.multiple)
CKDataTable(columns: cols, rows: data, sortColumnKey: 'name', sortAscending: false)
CKDataTable(columns: cols, rows: data, currentPage: 1, pageSize: 25)
CKDataTable.columns: CKTableColumn(key, label, type: CKColumnType (text|badge|avatarText|progress|custom), width, flex, minWidth, sortable, filterable, hidden, textAlign, badgeVariantBuilder, cellBuilder)
CKDataTable.notes: Omit onSortChanged to let the table sort in memory; editableColumns/onCellChanged are deprecated in favour of editableCells/onCellValueChanged.

CKAnimate.name: CKAnimate
CKAnimate.description: Entrance-animation wrapper. Wraps any widget with a fade, slide or scale effect driven by the theme's motion tokens. Respects the platform reduced-motion setting.

props.delay: Duration - Wait before starting, default zero
props.offset: double - Slide distance in px, default 16
props.autoPlay: bool - Start on first build, default true
props.trigger: Object? - Change this value to replay

CKAccordion.name: CKAccordion
CKAccordion.description: Expandable sections; one open at a time unless allowMultiple.

CKStepper.name: CKStepper
CKStepper.description: Step-by-step progress indicator, vertical or horizontal.
CKStepper.basicUsage:
CKStepper(
  steps: [
    CKStep(title: 'Account', status: StepStatus.completed),
    CKStep(title: 'Profile', status: StepStatus.inProgress),
    CKStep(title: 'Review', status: StepStatus.pending),
  ],
)
CKStepper.notes: StepStatus: completed, inProgress, pending, rejected. CKStepperOrientation: vertical (default), horizontal.

CKTimeline.name: CKTimeline
CKTimeline.description: Vertical or horizontal timeline of events.

CKListTile.name: CKListTile
CKListTile.description: List row with optional leading, subtitle and trailing widgets.
CKListTile.basicUsage:
CKListTile(
  leading: Icon(Icons.person),
  title: Text('Jane Doe'),
  subtitle: Text('Admin'),
  trailing: Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
  onTap: () {},
)

CKDivider.name: CKDivider
CKDivider.description: Thin separator line, horizontal by default. A vertical divider fills the height it is given.

CKContainer.name: CKContainer
CKContainer.description: Surface container with design-system background, border and padding.

CKFilterChip.name: CKFilterChip
CKFilterChip.notes: ChipState: defaultState, draft, selected, disabled, error.

CKInputChip.name: CKInputChip
CKInputChip.description: Chip with a remove button, for entered values or tags.

CKAvatarGroup.name: CKAvatarGroup
CKAvatarGroup.description: Overlapping group of CKAvatar widgets with a +N overflow.

CKNumberStepper.name: CKNumberStepper
CKNumberStepper.description: Integer input with increment and decrement buttons, styled like CKTextField.

CKOtpField.name: CKOtpField
CKOtpField.description: One-time-password input shown as fixed-width cells; numeric only.

CKRadio.name: CKRadio
CKRadio.description: Radio control with optional label; generic over the value type.
CKRadio.notes: Use CKRadio.success / CKRadio.error for status colouring (or variant: SwitchVariant).

CKAlert.name: CKAlert
CKAlert.description: Inline message with semantic variants and optional dismiss.
CKAlert.basicUsage: CKAlert(title: 'Heads up', message: 'Your trial ends soon')

CKToast.name: CKToast
CKToast.description: Toast notification widget with semantic variants. Use CKSnackbar to show one transiently.
CKToast.notes: ToastVariant: defaultToast, info, success, warning, error.

CKSnackbar.name: CKSnackbar
CKSnackbar.description: Shows a CKToast as transient feedback, by default floating at the top of the window.

props.show: static void show(BuildContext context, String message, {ToastVariant variant = defaultToast, Duration duration = 3s, CKSnackbarPosition position = top, VoidCallback? onDismiss, double? width})
props.hide: static void hide() - dismisses the top snackbar

CKSnackbar.notes: CKSnackbarPosition: top (default), bottom. Pass width to make the top snackbar narrower and centred.

CKLoadingState.name: CKLoadingState
CKLoadingState.description: Centered loader with an optional message.

CKProgressBar.name: CKProgressBar
CKProgressBar.description: Progress bar. value runs from 0 to maxValue (default 1.0).
CKProgressBar.notes: ProgressVariant: primary (default), success, warning, error, indeterminate.

CKSlider.name: CKSlider
CKSlider.description: Slider bound to a double value.

CKSkeleton.name: CKSkeleton
CKSkeleton.description: Placeholder block with a gentle pulse while content loads (skipped under reduced motion).

CKEmptyState.name: CKEmptyState
CKEmptyState.description: Centered message for a list, table or page with nothing to show.
CKEmptyState.basicUsage:
CKEmptyState(
  title: 'No results',
  description: 'Try a different search',
  action: CKButton(onPressed: () {}, child: Text('Reset')),
)

CKErrorState.name: CKErrorState
CKErrorState.description: Centered message for something that failed to load; shows a retry button when onRetry is set.
CKErrorState.basicUsage: CKErrorState(title: 'Could not load', description: 'Check your connection', onRetry: () {})

CKMenu.name: CKMenu
CKMenu.description: Menu opened from a trigger widget.
CKMenu.basicUsage:
CKMenu(
  trigger: Icon(Icons.more_vert),
  items: [
    CKMenuItem(label: 'Edit', icon: Icons.edit, onTap: () {}),
    CKMenuItem(label: 'Delete', destructive: true, onTap: () {}),
  ],
)

CKPopover.name: CKPopover
CKPopover.description: Panel anchored below a trigger; tapping the trigger toggles it.

CKBottomSheet.name: CKBottomSheet
CKBottomSheet.description: Bottom sheet following the design-system surface and spacing. Open it with CKBottomSheet.show.

props.title: String?
props.show: static Future<T?> show<T>({required BuildContext context, required List<Widget> children, String? title, VoidCallback? onClose, bool isDismissible = true})

CKTabs.name: CKTabs
CKTabs.description: Tabs with line (default), pill or card style.

CKBreadcrumb.name: CKBreadcrumb
CKBreadcrumb.description: Breadcrumb trail. Every item except the last is a link when it has onTap.
CKBreadcrumb.basicUsage:
CKBreadcrumb(
  items: [
    BreadcrumbItem(label: 'Home', onTap: () {}),
    BreadcrumbItem(label: 'Users', onTap: () {}),
    BreadcrumbItem(label: 'Jane'),
  ],
)

BreadcrumbItem.name: BreadcrumbItem
BreadcrumbItem.description: Item model for CKBreadcrumb (note: not CK-prefixed).

CKAppBar.name: CKAppBar
CKAppBar.description: App bar for Scaffold.appBar; primary (brand) background by default.
CKAppBar.basicUsage:
CKAppBar(
  title: Text('Dashboard'),
  trailing: [CKIconButton(icon: Icons.settings, onPressed: () {})],
)

CKBottomNavigation.name: CKBottomNavigation
CKBottomNavigation.basicUsage:
CKBottomNavigation(
  selectedIndex: 0,
  items: [
    CKNavItem(icon: Icons.home, label: 'Home'),
    CKNavItem(icon: Icons.search, label: 'Search'),
  ],
  onDestinationSelected: (i) {},
)

CKNavigationRail.name: CKNavigationRail
CKNavigationRail.description: Vertical navigation rail for tablet and desktop.
CKNavigationRail.basicUsage:
CKNavigationRail(
  selectedIndex: 0,
  items: [
    CKNavItem(icon: Icons.home, label: 'Home'),
    CKNavItem(icon: Icons.search, label: 'Search'),
  ],
  onDestinationSelected: (i) {},
)

CKNavItem.name: CKNavItem
CKNavItem.description: Destination model for CKBottomNavigation and CKNavigationRail.

CKDrawer.name: CKDrawer
CKDrawer.description: App drawer (Scaffold.drawer) with app name, optional user email and items.
CKDrawer.basicUsage:
CKDrawer(
  appName: 'My App',
  userEmail: 'jane@example.com',
  items: [
    CKDrawerItem(icon: Icons.home, label: 'Home'),
    CKDrawerItem(icon: Icons.settings, label: 'Settings'),
  ],
  selectedIndex: 0,
  onItemSelected: (i) {},
)

CKSideNav.name: CKSideNav
CKSideNav.description: Collapsible side navigation with sections, badges, branding and a profile card.
CKSideNav.basicUsage:
CKSideNav(
  brandName: 'My App',
  sections: [
    CKSideNavSection(label: 'Main', items: [
      CKSideNavItem(icon: Icons.dashboard, label: 'Dashboard', itemKey: 'dashboard'),
      CKSideNavItem(icon: Icons.people, label: 'Users', badge: 3, itemKey: 'users'),
    ]),
  ],
  selectedIndex: 0,
  onItemSelected: (i) {},
  selectedKey: 'dashboard',
  onItemSelectedKey: (key) {},
)
CKSideNav.notes: Prefer selectedKey / onItemSelectedKey (matched against CKSideNavItem.itemKey). selectedIndex and onItemSelected are deprecated but still required. SideNavStyle: surface (default), brand. The logo comes from the theme (theme.logos.nav) unless you pass logo.

CKSideNavSection.name: CKSideNavSection
CKSideNavSection.description: Section of items for CKSideNav, with an optional heading.

CKTableColumn.name: CKTableColumn

props.key: String - required; field name looked up in each row map
props.label: String - required; header text
props.type: CKColumnType (default: text) - text, badge, avatarText, progress, custom
props.flex: int (default: 1) - flex share when width is null
props.badgeVariantBuilder: BadgeVariant Function(dynamic value)? - for badge columns
props.cellBuilder: Widget Function(dynamic value, Map<String, dynamic> row)? - for custom columns

examples: CKTableColumn(key: 'role', label: 'Role', type: CKColumnType.badge, badgeVariantBuilder: (v) => v == 'Admin' ? BadgeVariant.primary : BadgeVariant.outline)
CKTableColumn.notes: CKTableColumn.fromStrings(['Name', 'Email']) builds simple columns (keys are the snake_case labels).

CKEditableCell.name: CKEditableCell
CKEditableCell.description: Editable-cell configuration for CKDataTable.editableCells (map of column key -> cell).

props.textField: factory({String? hint, String? label, int maxLines = 1, TextInputType? keyboardType, validator})
props.dropdown: factory({List<DropdownMenuItem>? items, itemsBuilder: (row) => items, String? hint, String? label, validator}) - one of items/itemsBuilder required
props.datePicker: factory({String? label, DateTime? firstDate, DateTime? lastDate, validator})
props.CKEditableCell(...): custom: builder: (context, value, onChanged, row, isActive, validationError) => Widget, validator
props.validator: String? Function(dynamic value, Map<String, dynamic> row)? - return null when valid; receives the whole row

examples: CKEditableCell.dropdown(items: const [DropdownMenuItem(value: 'A', child: Text('A'))], hint: 'Pick one')
CKEditableCell.notes: Use with CKDataTable(editableCells: {...}, onCellValueChanged: (rowKey, columnKey, newValue) {...}).

CKTableFilter.name: CKTableFilter
CKTableFilter.description: A single filter condition collected by CKDataTable (onFilterChanged); the table does not filter rows itself.
CKTableFilter.notes: CKFilterOperator: equals, notEquals, contains, startsWith, endsWith, greaterThan, lessThan, greaterThanOrEqual, lessThanOrEqual.

CKScreenLayout.name: CKScreenLayout
CKScreenLayout.description: Responsive shell: persistent side nav at >= 840px; below that the side nav is hidden and opens as an overlay from a hamburger menu.
CKScreenLayout.basicUsage:
CKScreenLayout(
  brandName: 'My App',
  sections: [
    CKSideNavSection(items: [CKSideNavItem(icon: Icons.home, label: 'Home', itemKey: 'home')]),
  ],
  selectedIndex: 0,
  onItemSelected: (i) {},
  selectedKey: 'home',
  onItemSelectedKey: (key) {},
  body: Center(child: Text('Home')),
)
CKScreenLayout.notes: Takes the same selection parameters as CKSideNav (prefer selectedKey / onItemSelectedKey).

CKApp.name: CKApp
CKApp.description: Drop-in replacement for MaterialApp that applies the brand theme. Use CKApp.router or CKApp.delegate for Navigator 2.0.

props.brightness: Brightness? - force light/dark; null follows the system
props.responsive: bool (default: false) - currently has no effect

CKApp.notes: Never nest a MaterialApp inside CKApp. Widgets above CKApp cannot read the theme.
